name: SocialPostCard
description: A generic social post: avatar, display name, handle, time text, body, an optional media slot and link preview slot, and a row of real buttons (reply, repost, like) with formatted counts. It is an article with no network branding.

handle.description: Handle of the author, with or without a leading @.

avatarSrc.description: Avatar image URL. Without it the initials are shown.

timestamp.description: Time as text, for example 2h or 12 Mar. Pass the already formatted text.

dateTime.description: Machine readable date for the time element.

media.description: Optional media slot under the body, such as an image.

linkPreview.description: Optional link preview slot under the media.

isLiked.description: Whether the current user liked the post.

isReposted.description: Whether the current user reposted it.

onReply.description: Called when Reply is pressed. The button is only drawn when this is set.

onRepost.description: Called when Repost is pressed. The button is only drawn when this is set.

onLike.description: Called when Like is pressed. The button is only drawn when this is set.

variant.description: Compact uses smaller spacing and text.

locale.description: Locale used to format counts. Defaults to the app locale.

keyboard: Tab: moves to each action button in order
Enter or Space: presses the focused button
requirements: The card is an article named by the author name through aria-labelledby
Reply, Repost and Like are real buttons with names like Reply, 12 replies; Repost and Like use aria-pressed
Counts are formatted with the default locale and compact notation, and the full number is in the accessible name
The avatar is decorative when the name is next to it; the time uses a time element
Media and link preview are slots: give images their own alt text
screenReader: Article with the author name, then body, media, then the action buttons with counts

use_when: Showing a post, quote or testimonial from a feed
Wall of reactions on a landing page
avoid_when: Long conversations that need threading and moderation
Anything that needs live updating counts without an announcement
